Patch Set 1:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks correct: the second multiop in 21d has never been waited for (it goes back to the original 2005 version of the test), so this matches the reported `multiop still running` failure. Only optional nits inline - no need to re-spin for them. Separately, 21e/21f/21g background a `touch` the same way and never wait for it; they don't trip the framework check because it only looks for multiop, but the race with the trailing `rm -rf` is the same if you want to cover them in a follow-up.

Uploaded patch set 2.
